svg.font-family: Be Vietnam, Montserrat, Segoe UI, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Cutaway architecture of the Binary Bin: a fixed top panel whose first third is a hinged load flap, a shuttle box open at the top and bottom that hangs from a single linear rail and travels over two bins, a sealed deck that acts as the shuttle floor, one servo drop hatch per bin, and a sealed service cavity under the load station.
svg.text: BINARY BIN · INTERNAL ARCHITECTURE · v2 SHUTTLE
Fixed top panel · hinged load flap over the first third · one travelling shuttle box · one drop hatch per bin
the top panel is fixed — only the load third ever opens
FIXED TOP PANEL — sealed, never opens
single linear rail + closed-loop belt — one axis, one motor
shuttle travels to the chosen bin
PLAN VIEW — FROM ABOVE, TOP PANEL REMOVED
One moving axis replaces the twin sweep arms. The shuttle is the only part that travels, and the
sealed deck underneath it is its floor, so nothing can fall until a hatch is commanded open.
Interlock: a hatch may open only while the shuttle is docked over it and the carriage is idle.
Only one hatch is ever energised, and the load flap stays shut for the whole travel cycle.

g.text: Fixed top panel — the other two thirds
Hinged load flap + servo — the open 1/3
IR break-beam — item entered the shuttle
Shuttle box — open top and open bottom
Home limit switch at the LOAD station
Wiper seal around the shuttle rim
ToF fill sensor, one per bin
Partition wall between the two bins
ON THE BIN — ESP32-S3 N16R8 (16 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM)
• OV2640/OV5640 + onboard flash LED — capture, JPEG-encode in PSRAM, never decode on-device
• Motion: 1 stepper (carriage) + 3 servos (flap, hatch 1, hatch 2) + home switch + break-beam
• Link: Wi-Fi HTTP POST is the default; the USB-UART framed link is the fallback and the console
ON THE LAPTOP — v1 inference host
• FastAPI /classify returns {label, bin, confidence, latency_ms} — MobileNetV3-Small backend
• Every frame is archived for labelling, so the dataset builds itself while the rig is demoed
v2 — MOVE INFERENCE TO THE EDGE
• Same /classify contract, served by an INT8 ESP-DL / TFLite-Micro model in PSRAM. No host.
Flash fires, the frame goes to
over the target bin and stops.
